reauth_synthetic_only.name: reauth_synthetic_only
reauth_synthetic_only.value: method = 'SYNTHETIC' AND assurance = 'TEST_ONLY' AND NOT adult_exclusive

sessions_check.name: sessions_check
sessions_check.value: ((mode = 'ANONYMOUS'::text) AND (family_id IS NULL) AND (parent_id IS NULL) AND (registration_id IS NULL) AND (child_id IS NULL)) OR ((mode = 'PARENT'::text) AND (family_id IS NOT NULL) AND (parent_id IS NOT NULL) AND (registration_id IS NOT NULL) AND (child_id IS NULL)) OR ((mode = 'CHILD'::text) AND (family_id IS NOT NULL) AND (parent_id IS NOT NULL) AND (registration_id IS NOT NULL) AND (child_id IS NOT NULL))

answer_runs_hashes_check.name: answer_runs_hashes_check
answer_runs_hashes_check.value:
request_hash ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'
      AND (input_hash IS NULL OR input_hash ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$')

answer_runs_epoch_check.name: answer_runs_epoch_check
answer_runs_epoch_check.value:
access_epoch > 0 AND child_access_epoch > 0 AND session_privilege_epoch > 0
      AND kill_epoch > 0 AND fence >= 0

answer_runs_safety_action_check.name: answer_runs_safety_action_check

challenge_versions_curated_check.name: challenge_versions_curated_check
challenge_versions_curated_check.value: origin='CURATED' AND distribution_scope='CATALOG' AND status='PUBLISHED' AND risk_class='MINIMAL_RISK' AND supervision_requirement='NONE'
